items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I know how he is, I never heard him play, if he played there.

ctx.x: And it might come up, we might make some, some little recordings on the tape or something sometime and you'll be in good shape for it.
Yeah. Well, I don't know, I promise to see Pudge, talking to him, and just to put up a short band.
